title: Read summaries, page deliberately, then select full detail
when: A QA plan catalog, session roster or steering report is large or deployment run history
need: QA and session lists serve 25-row summary pages; QA plan --full adds detail to the same page and never returns the whole catalog, and the web Test plans view loads one page per project with Load more. JSON chooses format and obeys the same 28,000-byte CLI bound. A refused read prints no partial answer and names narrowing or --full. Steering JSON computes complete facts; --json --full permits the full reply. Hook and watcher digests compose alarm inputs and return compact disappearance identities. Deployment-run CLI lists serve byte-bounded summary pages with a continuation cursor; get accepts several fields without reading large unrequested columns.
surface: CLI help, command results and refusals
recipes: yoke deployment-runs get RUN-ID status current_stage release_lineage
